skills.elemental_skill: Performs a swift thrust, dealing Electro DMG to opponents along the path. When Cyno is under the Pathsworn Pathclearer state triggered by Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness, he will instead unleash a Mortuary Rite that deals thunderous AoE Electro DMG and extends the duration of Pathsworn Pathclearer. When Skill DMG hits at least one enemy, it generates Elemental Particles. When Mortuary Rite DMG hits at least one enemy, it generates Elemental Particles. When this skill is used, both CDs will be triggered. When outside of his Elemental Burst, the normal CD will be used. During his Elemental Burst, the Mortuary Rite CD will be used.
